title: BUG: PIV/OpenPGP TLV parser assumes single-byte BER length encoding
description: wp11_piv_sign() and wp11_openpgp response parsers increment i once to skip the length byte after 7C, then look for the inner tag. Real ISO 7816 BER-TLV allows multi-byte lengths (0x81 followed by 1-byte length, 0x82 followed by 2-byte length). If a token responds with a value > 127 bytes in the DAT envelope, the parser misaligns and reads garbage tags. Fix: after finding 7C, decode the BER length properly (handle 0x81 and 0x82 prefix bytes); add comment citing ISO 7816-4 Section 5.2.2. Add WP11_PIV_ERR_ENCODING error code for this case.
